info.title: cdidx
info.description: AI-native local code index for CLI and MCP workflows. Index source code into SQLite, search with FTS5, and return structured results for humans and agents. Distributed as a .NET global tool — CLI and MCP server only; no public library / SDK API is provided (see INTEGRATION_POLICY.md). / CLIとMCPワークフロー向けのAIネイティブなローカルコードインデックス。ソースコードをSQLiteにインデックスし、FTS5で検索し、人間とAI向けに構造化された結果を返す。.NET グローバルツールとして配布され、CLI と MCP サーバーのみを提供します。公開ライブラリ/SDK API は提供しません（INTEGRATION_POLICY.md 参照）。

options.name: --db
options.description:
Database file path (default for index: <projectPath>/.cdidx/codeindex.db)
Database file path (default: .cdidx/codeindex.db in current directory)

options.name: --rebuild
options.description: Delete existing DB and rebuild from scratch

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Query commands: emit debug diagnostics to stderr; with --json, append an _debug JSON object

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Scan files without writing to the database

options.name: --force
options.description: Bypass the per-database index lock; only use when no other cdidx index is active

options.name: --json
options.description: Output as JSON (search streams ndjson by default; use search --json=array for one array)

options.name: --silent
options.description: Query commands: suppress informational stderr output, including zero-result hints and summaries; errors still print. Overrides --verbose stderr text.

options.name: --max-file-bytes
options.description: Index only files up to this size (default: 4MiB; also honors CDIDX_MAX_FILE_BYTES; accepts K/M/G suffixes)

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Full-scan extraction workers (default: CPU count capped at 16; also honors CDIDX_INDEX_PARALLELISM)

options.name: --include-symbol-kind
options.description: Keep only matching symbol kinds during indexing

options.name: --exclude-symbol-kind
options.description: Drop matching symbol kinds during indexing

options.name: --commits
options.description: Update only files changed in the specified git commits (preferred after commits)

options.name: --changed-between
options.description: Update only files changed between two git refs (useful after branch switches)

options.name: --files
options.description: Update only the specified files; old rename/delete paths are not purged unless also listed

options.name: --watch
options.description: After the initial scan, stay running and reindex on file changes (FileSystemWatcher / inotify / FSEvents); rejects --commits / --changed-between / --files / --dry-run

options.name: --debounce
options.description: Watch only: coalesce bursts of file events into one update after <ms> of quiet (default: 500)

options.name: --optimize
options.description: index only: optimize the existing FTS5 table for this project's DB without scanning files

options.name: --color
options.description: Color output: `auto` (default), `always`, or `never`; flag wins over `CLICOLOR_FORCE` / `NO_COLOR` / `CLICOLOR` env vars, which win over TTY auto-detect

options.name: --palette
options.description: ANSI palette: `basic` (8-color, default fallback), `256`, or `truecolor`; flag wins over `CDIDX_COLOR_PALETTE` env var, which wins over `COLORTERM` / `TERM` auto-detect

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Use ASCII spinner/progress glyphs instead of Unicode glyphs (also honors CDIDX_ASCII=1, NO_UNICODE, TERM=dumb, accessibility env hints, and non-UTF-8 locales)

options.name: --metrics
options.description: Append one JSONL record per CLI command / MCP tool call to <path> (also honors CDIDX_METRICS=<path>)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --license
options.description: Show licensing, trademark, and commercial-use summary

options.name: --completions
options.description:
Generate shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
Update workflows:
Use --commits with a project path after normal commits; git diff sees rename/delete paths too.
Use --changed-between <old-ref> <new-ref> after switching branches to refresh only changed files.
Use --files only for known in-place edits or new files; old rename/delete paths stay indexed unless also listed.
Incremental writes optimize FTS5 opportunistically after a small maintenance threshold; run `cdidx optimize` for manual maintenance.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Read commands: append SQL timing, row-count, and EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN JSON after the normal result

options.name: --slow-query-ms
options.description: Read commands: log profiled SQL statements that take at least <n> ms (use 0 to log every statement)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Max results to return (default: 20)

options.name: --lang
options.description: Filter by language (aliases: bat, cmd, cshtml, razor, ts, tsx, cts, mts)

options.name: --path
options.description: Restrict matches to glob-style path patterns (* and ?)

options.name: --query
options.description: Pass a query literal, useful when the query starts with '-' (`search` max 1000 chars)

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Exclude glob-style path patterns (* and ?) (repeatable)

options.name: --exclude-tests
options.description: Exclude likely test files

options.name: --include-generated
options.description: Include generated files in query results

options.name: --snippet-lines
options.description: Search snippet length (1-20, default: 8)

options.name: --snippet-focus
options.description: search only: long-line focus mode (leftmost|quality|proximity, default: quality)

options.name: --max-line-width
options.description: search/references/find/excerpt/inspect only: clamp very long single-line snippet/context/excerpt payloads (`0` disables clamping; default: 512)

options.name: --focus-line
options.description: excerpt: line whose focused column should stay visible (requires --focus-column)

options.name: --focus-column
options.description: excerpt: column to keep centered when clamping (must be within the focused line)

options.name: --focus-length
options.description: excerpt: width of the focused span (default: 1, requires --focus-column)

options.name: --fts
options.description: Use raw FTS5 query syntax for search (search query max 1000 chars; raw FTS parser max 2000 chars, 64 boolean ops, 16 NEAR ops; trailing * is a prefix shorthand in literal-safe mode)

options.name: --exact
options.description:
Backward-compatible shorthand.
Prefer --exact-substring for search,
--exact for find,
and --exact-name for symbol/graph lookups.
Combining exact-match flags is rejected.

options.name: --exact-substring
options.description:
Search only: case-sensitive exact substring
(no FTS5)

options.name: --exact-name
options.description:
Exact name match for symbols, definition,
references, callers, callees, and inspect.
Uses NFKC + Unicode CaseFold when ready.
Legacy/stale-fold DBs fall back to ASCII NOCASE;
run `cdidx backfill-fold` or check fold_ready.

options.name: --kind
options.description: definition/symbols/hotspots/unused: symbol kind; references: reference kind (call/instantiate/subscribe/attribute/annotation); callers/callees: call-graph kinds only (call/instantiate/subscribe — metadata kinds rejected, use references instead); validate: issue kind

options.name: --visibility
options.description: Filter symbols/definitions/unused/hotspots by visibility: public, protected, internal, private

options.name: --count
options.description: Count only; search/definition/references/callers/callees/symbols/files/find/unused ignore --limit, impact/hotspots still use visible page counts

options.name: --since
options.description: Filter to files modified since this timestamp (ISO 8601)

options.name: --bytes
options.description: Show raw byte counts in human output for files/map instead of binary units; JSON always keeps raw integer bytes

options.name: --max-hops
options.description: Max BFS hops for impact analysis, inclusive (default: 5; --max-hops 2 returns callers at hop 1 and 2; --max-hops 0 resolves the symbol without traversing callers)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Deprecated alias for --max-hops

options.name: --reverse
options.description: Reverse direction for deps (show dependents)

options.name: --group-by-name
options.description: hotspots: collapse rows sharing (name, kind) across files into one line

options.name: --with-paths
options.description:
impact: also emit `paths` per caller — the shortest call chains [root, ..., caller] (diamond graphs surface every converging route, capped per row)
unused reflection note     C# nameof/typeof and direct reflection member-name literals such as GetMethod("Foo") are indexed; dynamically constructed reflection names may need manual review
Note: if a query itself starts with '-', pass it with --query <query> or -- <query>; for option values that start with '--', use --opt=<value>.
